description_en: Creates a model creation service API key
kebab_example: aliyun polardb create-aidb-cluster-api-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --description test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAIDBClusterApiKey

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query the region information of all clusters under the specified account.
If this parameter is left empty, scheduled tasks in all regions under the current account are queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看目标账号下所有的集群的地域信息。
若该参数留空，默认查询当前账号下所有地域内的计划任务
parameters.name: region_id
